# Every hold the instrument sees is a row. Two processes of one program are
# two rows; a process the platform would not attribute keeps its image and an
# empty account; held sums the verified rows alone, never an engine's claim.
measure card:0 capacity=24GiB
sample card:0 llama-server 4GiB
sample card:0 llama-server 2GiB
sample card:0 image:dwm.exe 512MiB
engine card:0 server:lmstudio 96GiB
table card:0

# expect 6: ok capacity=24GiB held=6656MiB rows=dwm.exe/-/verified/512MiB,llama-server/S-1-5-21-7-1001/verified/2GiB,llama-server/S-1-5-21-7-1001/verified/4GiB,server:lmstudio/-/claimed/0 [RES-T1]
